scope: READ_ONLY_CONCEPTUAL_LOCAL_HISTORY_AND_BAN_SCREEN_OF_EXACT_PROPOSED_GRAPH_ONLY; no implementation source exists and no scientific admission, literature novelty, resource or execution approval follows.

proposal_as_supplied_by_root.support: EXACT existing FLE K32 recipient native fine-leaf support and symmetric cutoff tie fallback
proposal_as_supplied_by_root.edge_message: m_ij = W2 GELU(Wr x_i + Wd (x_j - x_i) + b) + b2
proposal_as_supplied_by_root.readout: per-recipient fixed equal mean over that support
proposal_as_supplied_by_root.factorized_equivalent: u_i = W2 mean_j GELU((Wr-Wd)x_i + Wd x_j + b) + b2
proposal_as_supplied_by_root.activation: actual inherited native GELU, not proposed relu change
proposal_as_supplied_by_root.changed_path: fine point readback only; M95 middle/coarse banks/FFNs, original fusion/CSORT/HCG and single inst_feats writeback retained

why_not_FLE_duplicate: FLE per head returns a positive scalar softmax-weighted combination of unchanged donor vectors. The proposed mixed receiver/donor nonlinearity constructs a signed D-vector on every edge before private recipient aggregation. It can change channel content beyond scalar donor reweighting while keeping the exact original supports; this is a functional structural change, not a K/head/temperature sweep.

nearest_comparisons.overlap: Same native fine-leaf point edges and recipient output support.
nearest_comparisons.difference: Scalar/head donor selection versus joint nonlinear edge-value construction.
nearest_comparisons.limitation: FLE negative realization remains stopped; its result cannot be relabelled or resumed under this new operator.

nearest_comparisons.overlap: Receiver-conditioned nonlinear vector message followed by fixed mean is already used locally.
nearest_comparisons.difference: CRE messages operate between supported coarse-root tokens and then reconstruct fine/middle tokens; proposal operates directly on point receivers/donors within bounded fine leaves and preserves larger-scale M95 paths.
nearest_comparisons.limitation: Primitive is not new; only task-specific graph placement/value construction is a prospective difference.

nearest_comparisons.overlap: Joint endpoint transformation before fixed equal means.
nearest_comparisons.difference: BEC is fine/middle child-parent bank analysis and top-down synthesis, not native fine-leaf point-pair readback.
DCE excludes reverse edges on a three-level token forest and synthesizes all levels; no such cavity or cross-level replacement occurs here.
Disjoint two-output/multi-round cyclic token composition differs from one stateless fixed-support private point-edge mean.
Sequential Euler persistent node state / persistent line-graph edge state differ from one fixed-support edge-value transform.

NDE conditions each point on its shared fine token and emits one pooled leaf descriptor before ancestry synthesis; proposal conditions each edge on distinct native point receiver/donor and retains recipient-specific outputs.

ban_screen.attnpool_qcond_agg_multi: Not a learned weighted/shared leaf-token pooling or extra token set if every original point retains its own private edge result. Fixed mean alone is not evidence of a forbidden pooled-token rename; approved CRE/BEC already use fixed means. Reject if the implementation collapses to one shared fine token or learned scalar pooling weights.
ban_screen.gate_residual_route: No learned gate, sigmoid/softmax channel weight, new residual/injection coefficient, language route, or explicit routing is in the supplied graph. Preserve only the original approved M95 fusion/single writeback; reject added correction gates/residual branches.
ban_screen.large_QKVO_N2: Block-head pair transforms with inherited H8/D32 and fixed K32 are not large QKV/O projections or global N-squared attention. Actual full-model cost remains unmeasured.
ban_screen.Phase1_numeric_tuning: K32/H8/GELU and original data/seed/schedule/loss stay fixed. Joint nonlinear edge-value construction is a graph computation change; 25K parameters by itself is not the admission argument. No width/head/activation/scalar sweep.
ban_screen.stopped_FLE_branch: A different structurally defined new proposal may be screened; M203/FLE weights, run, revisions and stopped negative conclusion remain untouched. Do not call it a rescued/restarted FLE realization.

historical_negative_evidence.reference_limit: Available frozen M95 epoch16 reference is not independently verified as historical champion weights.
historical_negative_evidence.interpretation: FLE scalar weighting was negatively target-aligned relative to uniform support on the fixed TRAIN cohort; QF readout mainly changed point path with broad IoU uncertainty. These facts support examining value construction as a distinguishable question, not a proof of a channel-specific bottleneck, benefit, or generalization.

critical_conditions_before_admission: Write the exact formula/support/fallback/integration and its degeneracies; distinguish real receiver-donor coupling from sender-only embedding or shared-token pooling.

Include a matched own-only or receiver/donor-content control: a new self transform can change masks even when neighbor information contributes nothing. Do not call output/gradient activity neighbor benefit.
Verify first-affine pre-gather and W2 post-mean rearrangements preserve the stated function, finite behavior and padding/tie semantics without persistent caches.
Retain original M95/native protocol and all historical negative results; full native backward/resource/independence/constraints and scientific motivation/literature checks remain required.
Do not assert novelty from a new name or a familiar pair-message primitive. No original-paper comparison was performed by this local-history screen.
